name: Aizawa
source:
Aizawa is professor from the university division and an adviser to the science club at Sora's school. He is hard to bump into, but even after a brief encounter, he comes across as someone you wouldn't want to get close to.

[Edited from [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/sukisho/sukisho1.php]Boys' Love Game Headquarters[/url]]
